'
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

FS = 2  # font/linewidth supersampling factor (figure is also scaled by this)

df = dataset.copy()
df.columns = ["Segment", "Cluster", "Halted", "Stopped"]
df["Halted"] = df["Halted"].fillna(0.0)
df["Stopped"] = df["Stopped"].fillna(0.0)

SEG_LABELS = {"hydration": "Hydration", "foil": "Foil", "schubert": "Schubert",
              "manual": "Manual", "unattributed": "Other", "web": "Web / Reel",
              "sealing": "Sealing", "handling": "Handling", "pneumatic": "Pneumatic"}
SEG_COLORS = {"hydration": "#e76f51", "foil": "#e9c46a", "schubert": "#2a9d8f",
              "manual": "#636e72", "unattributed": "#b2bec3",
              "web": "#3B82F6", "sealing": "#F59E0B", "handling": "#8B5CF6",
              "pneumatic": "#10B981"}
SEG_ORDER = {"hydration": 0, "foil": 1, "schubert": 2, "web": 0, "sealing": 1,
             "handling": 2, "pneumatic": 3, "manual": 10, "unattributed": 11}

def hex_blend(hexcolor, ratio):
    r = int(hexcolor[1:3], 16); g = int(hexcolor[3:5], 16); b = int(hexcolor[5:7], 16)
    if ratio >= 0:
        r = int(r + (255 - r) * ratio); g = int(g + (255 - g) * ratio); b = int(b + (255 - b) * ratio)
    else:
        f = 1 + ratio; r = int(r * f); g = int(g * f); b = int(b * f)
    return "#%02x%02x%02x" % (max(0, min(255, r)), max(0, min(255, g)), max(0, min(255, b)))

grouped = df.groupby("Segment").agg(Halted=("Halted", "sum"), Stopped=("Stopped", "sum")).reset_index()
grouped["Total"] = grouped["Halted"] + grouped["Stopped"]
grouped = grouped[grouped["Total"] > 0]
grouped["Order"] = grouped["Segment"].map(lambda s: SEG_ORDER.get(s, 5))
grouped = grouped.sort_values(["Order", "Segment"])

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(15.6 * FS, 7.0 * FS), dpi=150)

if grouped.empty:
    ax.axis("off")
    ax.text(0.5, 0.5, "No downtime recorded for this selection", ha="center", va="center",
            fontsize=13 * FS, color="#636e72")
else:
    GAP = 0.4
    max_hours = grouped["Total"].max() or 1.0
    y_cursor = 0.0
    row_defs = []
    seg_label_pos = []
    for _, seg_row in grouped.iterrows():
        seg = seg_row["Segment"]
        base_color = SEG_COLORS.get(seg, "#b2bec3")
        label = SEG_LABELS.get(seg, str(seg).title())
        sub = df[df["Segment"] == seg]
        cl = sub.groupby("Cluster").agg(Halted=("Halted", "sum"), Stopped=("Stopped", "sum")).reset_index()
        cl["Total"] = cl["Halted"] + cl["Stopped"]
        cl = cl.sort_values("Total", ascending=False).reset_index(drop=True)
        n = len(cl)
        shades = [hex_blend(base_color, (i * 0.5 / max(n - 1, 1)) if n > 1 else 0.0) for i in range(n)]
        start_row = y_cursor
        halted_total = seg_row["Halted"]
        stopped_total = seg_row["Stopped"]
        if halted_total > 0:
            row_defs.append({"y": y_cursor, "kind": "halted", "total": halted_total,
                              "stack": list(zip(cl["Cluster"], cl["Halted"], shades))})
            y_cursor += 1.0
        if stopped_total > 0:
            row_defs.append({"y": y_cursor, "kind": "stopped", "total": stopped_total,
                              "stack": list(zip(cl["Cluster"], cl["Stopped"], shades))})
            y_cursor += 1.0
        end_row = y_cursor - 1.0
        seg_label_pos.append((seg, (start_row + end_row) / 2.0, label, seg_row["Total"]))
        y_cursor += GAP

    BASELINE = 8.0
    ylim_end = max(y_cursor - GAP + 0.15, BASELINE)
    ax.set_xlim(0, max_hours * 1.02)
    ax.set_ylim(-0.5, ylim_end)
    ax.invert_yaxis()
    ax.axis("off")

    trans = ax.get_yaxis_transform()
    label_x, sub_x, right_x = -0.235, -0.085, 1.02

    pending_texts = []  # (text_obj, bar_x0_data, bar_w_data, full_label, short_label)
    for row in row_defs:
        y = row["y"]
        ax.barh(y, max_hours, height=0.78, color="#f0f1f5", zorder=1, left=0)
        cum = 0.0
        for name, hours, shade in row["stack"]:
            if hours <= 0:
                continue
            ax.barh(y, hours, height=0.78, left=cum, color=shade, zorder=2, edgecolor="white", linewidth=1.2)
            full_label = "%s %.1fh" % (name, hours)
            t = ax.text(cum + hours / 2.0, y, full_label, ha="center", va="center", fontsize=9.5 * FS,
                        color="white", fontweight="600", zorder=3, clip_on=True)
            pending_texts.append((t, cum, hours, full_label, name))
            cum += hours
        kind_label = "halted" if row["kind"] == "halted" else "stopped"
        kind_color = "#2d3436" if row["kind"] == "halted" else "#636e72"
        kind_weight = "bold" if row["kind"] == "halted" else "normal"
        ax.text(sub_x, y, kind_label, ha="right", va="center", fontsize=9.5 * FS,
                color=kind_color, fontweight=kind_weight, transform=trans)
        ax.text(right_x, y, "%.1fh" % row["total"], ha="left", va="center", fontsize=9.5 * FS,
                color="#636e72", transform=trans)

    for seg, y_mid, label, total in seg_label_pos:
        ax.text(label_x, y_mid - 0.16, label, ha="right", va="center", fontsize=10.5 * FS,
                color="#2d3436", fontweight="600", transform=trans)
        ax.text(label_x, y_mid + 0.18, "%.1fh total" % total, ha="right", va="center", fontsize=9 * FS,
                color="#636e72", transform=trans)

    fig.subplots_adjust(left=0.235, right=0.90, top=0.98, bottom=0.065)
    fig.text(0.235, 0.014,
              "halted = operator wait (machine parked)      stopped = auto-stop (fault recovery)",
              fontsize=9 * FS, color="#636e72")

    # --- text-fit safety net: shrink to name-only, or hide, if a label doesn''t
    # actually fit inside its own bar segment''s rendered pixel width ---
    fig.canvas.draw()
    renderer = fig.canvas.get_renderer()
    to_recheck = []
    for t, x0, w, full_label, short_label in pending_texts:
        bar_px = abs(ax.transData.transform((x0 + w, 0))[0] - ax.transData.transform((x0, 0))[0])
        if t.get_window_extent(renderer=renderer).width > bar_px * 0.94:
            t.set_text(short_label)
            to_recheck.append((t, bar_px, short_label))
    if to_recheck:
        fig.canvas.draw()
        for t, bar_px, short_label in to_recheck:
            if t.get_window_extent(renderer=renderer).width > bar_px * 0.94:
                t.set_text("")

plt.show()
